patch.value: Apply Fleet CI v2 quick PR and deep tiers
Companion pm-cli-website-dyhg. Preserve all release checks while reducing hosted PR repetition and seeded depth.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Plan: preserve required test (22.18.0) and test (26); audit docs and identity inputs; retain committed dist verification. Latest successful main run 43706369121 returns no combined log, so inspect job logs and seeded source. Deep tier keeps both full npm and Bun gates per Node version. Release rollout files remain owned by pm-ops#272.

value.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build:test && npm run lint

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Baseline job logs recovered through the jobs API: Node 22.18.0 executes in 4m30s; Node 26 in 8m03s, but creation-to-completion is 62m14s and 128m04s. Longest seeded suite: 68.55s; calibration 18.50s; drift 15.82s. Typecheck, test typecheck and lint passed through pm test. Strict workflow YAML parsing passed (actionlint unavailable). Quick touched suites and one quick coverage run are in progress. Local npm install required clearing an inherited user npm allow-scripts configuration; no repository configuration changed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Docs gate input audit: README is read by smoke.test.ts; package dry-run includes README and CHANGELOG; identity-audit examines git identities and added lines, including tracker prose. All stay in the docs path. Seeded suites use deterministic prefixes; calibration minimum samples is derived from generated valid episodes, with explicit nonempty success and exclusion categories. Frozen compatibility digest now checks a separately recorded 30-case prefix in quick mode. No product time budget is scaled.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Quick-prefix validation found zero blocked-start attempts in the first 50 drift cases. Added deterministic blocked-start refusals to drift and waiting without changing the seeded generator, and derive seeded refusal totals from the independent model. Historical strict-health provenance warning remains advisory and exits zero. Quick coverage and touched suites are still running; no full local test depth was invoked.

value.command: PM_TEST_DEPTH=quick node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/calibration.test.ts test/drift.test.ts test/waiting.test.ts test/schedule-boundaries.test.ts test/duration-input.test.ts test/duration-output.test.ts

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: PR #242 is published; CI run 43731128929 remains queued for both required checks, so wall time is unavailable. Final quick seeded calibration, drift and waiting regression selection passed via pm test. Earlier touched-files run passed 34 of 35 tests; the lone failure was the now-corrected zero-refusal drift prefix, separately rerun successfully. The one quick coverage run began before that correction and is not exact-head passing evidence; defer confirmation to PR CI. No full local run. Item remains in_progress and unclaimed for orchestrator review.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Correction to the previous receipt: the touched-files invocation reported 49 tests, 48 passed and one corrected drift-prefix failure, in 171.99 seconds. The final seeded regression rerun passed all three selected tests in 39.51 seconds. No new full-depth timing was measured.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final local evidence: the pre-correction quick coverage attempt was stopped after its known drift-prefix assertion failure to avoid wasting shared capacity. Corrected seeded regression tests pass (3/3, 39.51s). No current-head aggregate coverage pass is claimed. PR #242 has queued required checks; latest observed CI run 43731375781. Follow the PR checks for superseding tracker-receipt pushes. All changes are pushed, author email verified, item released and left in_progress. Risks: pending hosted CI and deep certification; inherited provenance advisory.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final cross-check found that canonical publish-attestation discovery examines the first line of every tracked file for a shell shebang. Docs and tracker changes can therefore affect it. Add the existing verifier to the docs path and document that input scope; do not change verifier scripts or code-tier gates. Workflow YAML and whitespace checks pass. CI remains deferred to the orchestrator; no additional local suite is needed for this workflow-only correction.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round C: verify the supplied review findings, repair failing checks, audit CI tier boundaries and harness controls, and run focused gates. Review threads remain untouched; no merge or closure.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: CodeQL finding is valid: replace blanket tracker exclusion with inert data extensions; root and nested JS/MJS/CJS/TS tracker files remain eligible, verified with glob matching. Self-review checks documentation/privacy/identity gates, unscaled product budgets, integer timeouts, validation before spawn, platform filenames and generated-only quick thresholds.

value.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint --if-present && npm run build && npm run build:test && PM_TEST_DEPTH=quick node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/ci-codeql.test.ts test/release-workflow.test.ts && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from "node:fs"; import {parseDocument} from "yaml"; for(const file of readdirSync(".github/workflows").filter(f=>/\.ya?ml$/.test(f))){ const d=parseDocument(readFileSync(".github/workflows/"+file,"utf8"),{uniqueKeys:true}); if(d.errors.length) throw new Error(file+": "+d.errors.join(";")); } console.log("Strict workflow YAML passed");'

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round C validation passed: typecheck, test TypeScript compilation, focused behavior and workflow/tooling suites, strict unique-key YAML parsing, and package changelog regeneration/check. Lint passed where the package provides a lint script; packages without one passed their existing docstring gate. No configured coverage source changed, so no package coverage run was added. Existing isolated coverage-tooling fixtures are part of the focused tooling suites. All supplied review findings are valid and repaired. Self-review additionally preserves executable tracker scans and all applicable docs/privacy/identity/package/attestation gates. Product budgets and coverage thresholds remain unchanged. Validation uses the local Node 24 runtime; Node 22/26, native Windows and deep runtime certification remain CI evidence. Threads untouched; no merge or item closure. Release ownership after recording this evidence.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round E: verified assigned review findings and current checks. Fix valid portability, gate-order and timeout regressions; preserve product deadlines, privacy/identity and self-host gates. Run targeted quick tests and required tooling checks before an explicit-path commit. Review threads remain untouched.

value.command: npm run brand:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:test && PM_TEST_DEPTH=quick PM_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3 node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/ci-brand.test.ts test/brand-values.test.ts test/ci-codeql.test.ts test/release-workflow.test.ts && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync,readdirSync,existsSync} from '"'"'node:fs'"'"'; import assert from '"'"'node:assert/strict'"'"'; import {parseDocument} from '"'"'yaml'"'"'; for(const dir of ['"'"'.github/workflows'"'"','"'"'templates/backend/.github/workflows'"'"']) if(existsSync(dir)) for(const file of readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>/\.ya?ml$/.test(f))) {const d=parseDocument(readFileSync(dir+'"'"'/'"'"'+file,'"'"'utf8'"'"'),{uniqueKeys:true,strict:true});assert.deepEqual(d.errors,[],file);assert.deepEqual(d.warnings,[],file);} console.log('"'"'Strict workflow YAML passed'"'"');'

npm run typecheck && npm run lint --if-present && npm run build:test && PM_TEST_DEPTH=quick PM_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3 node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/ci-routing.test.ts && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync,readdirSync,existsSync} from "node:fs"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {parseDocument} from "yaml"; for(const dir of [".github/workflows","templates/backend/.github/workflows"]) if(existsSync(dir)) for(const file of readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>/\.ya?ml$/.test(f))) {const d=parseDocument(readFileSync(dir+"/"+file,"utf8"),{uniqueKeys:true,strict:true});assert.deepEqual(d.errors,[],file);assert.deepEqual(d.warnings,[],file);} console.log("Strict workflow YAML passed");'

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round E evidence: PRRT_kwDOSYpIas63tpkT is valid: build regenerated committed brand values before validation. Both quick matrix legs now run brand:check before any build; ci-brand.test.ts asserts ordering. Brand, targeted workflow tests, typecheck, lint and strict YAML passed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round E final verification: typecheck, lint (docstring gate where no lint script exists), touched regression tests, workflow/tooling tests, strict workflow YAML and changelog:check passed. Duplication gates passed where provided. Self-review retained docs/tracker privacy and identity checks, unscaled product deadlines, integer-rounded validated harness budgets, platform filename guards and generated-only quick thresholds. No package coverage sources were edited; no package coverage run. No review thread actions or merge. Shared-runner hold and SteveBot commit identity will be checked before push. Hosted CI is intentionally not awaited.
